headword: {学習指導要領|がくしゅうしどうようりょう}
reading: がくしゅうしどうようりょう
gloss: curriculum guidelines; course of study (national educational standards)

definitions.explanation: The national educational standards issued by Japan's Ministry of Education (MEXT), defining what students should learn at each level of schooling. Revised approximately every ten years.

examples.english: The new curriculum guidelines will be implemented starting next year.

notes:
The official framework governing education in Japan, issued by {文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう} (MEXT, the Ministry of Education). It prescribes subjects, content, and objectives for elementary, junior high, and high school. Major revisions affect everything from textbook content to school schedules. The most recent revision emphasizes ⟦{主体的|しゅたいてき}→主体的：05749_shutaiteki⟧・{対話的|たいわてき}で⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{学|まな}び (proactive, interactive, and deep learning).
